descriptions.0: Major contradiction or critical meaning loss
descriptions.1: Substantial semantic drift or alteration of key proposition
descriptions.2: Minor drift; core meaning remains intact
descriptions.3: Complete meaning preservation; no semantic loss or addition

descriptions.0: Unacceptable grammar; severely broken Sinhala syntax
descriptions.3: Fully well-formed, natural, and standard Sinhala grammar

descriptions.0: Erroneous case, tense, or subject-verb agreement inflection
descriptions.2: Minor non-standard inflection that does not impede comprehension
descriptions.3: Accurate, natural morphological inflection and agreement

descriptions.0: Highly unnatural, mechanical, or incomprehensible Sinhala
descriptions.1: Stilted or awkward phrasing; clearly artificial
descriptions.2: Mostly fluent; minor colloquial or stylistic stiffness

descriptions.SIMPLER: Candidate is noticeably simpler than the source sentence
descriptions.SAME: Candidate is approximately equal in complexity to the source
descriptions.MORE_COMPLEX: Candidate is more complex or difficult than the source
descriptions.UNCERTAIN: Relative complexity is ambiguous or mixed

descriptions.0: Entirely inaccessible; high-register or archaic terms for ages 4-8
descriptions.1: Several words too advanced for 4-8 year olds
descriptions.2: Mostly accessible words; 1-2 words require guidance
descriptions.3: Fully accessible, everyday core vocabulary suitable for ages 4-8

descriptions.0: Excessive clause embedding, overwhelming memory load for ages 4-8
descriptions.1: Overly long or complex compound sentence structure
descriptions.2: Slightly long sentence but manageable comprehension burden
descriptions.3: Short, clear, direct single-clause or simple coordinate structure

descriptions.0: Developmentally inappropriate concepts, themes, or structure
descriptions.2: Provisional developmental match with minor support needed
descriptions.3: Highly developmentally appropriate for children aged 4-8

descriptions.NO_FLAG: Candidate text contains no harmful, distressing, or unsafe elements
descriptions.UNSUITABLE: Explicitly inappropriate, frightening, or harmful content
descriptions.UNCERTAIN: Unable to determine safety without further contextual inquiry

descriptions.ACCEPT_DRAFT: Recommended as valid simplified draft candidate
descriptions.REVISE: Requires significant rule adjustment or re-simplification
descriptions.ESCALATE: Requires senior governance or ethical adjudication
